title: RISC-V page table entry (PTE)
summary: A RISC-V Sv39 (39-bit virtual address) page table entry is 8 bytes (64 bits). Fields: V (valid, bit 0), R (read, bit 1), W (write, bit 2), X (execute, bit 3), U (user, bit 4), G (global, bit 5), A (accessed, bit 6), D (dirty, bit 7), RSW (bits 8-9, reserved for software), PPN (physical page number, bits 10-53), reserved (bits 54-63). Sv48 and Sv57 extend the virtual address space with additional levels.

notes: RISC-V Sv39: 39-bit virtual address, 3-level paging (L2 -> L1 -> L0).
satp (Supervisor Address Translation and Protection) register holds the page table base and ASID.
RISC-V has no hardware dirty bit in early versions (software must emulate A/D bits).
